boards.title: Your First Weekend at Simpson College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A conservative, under-21-safe first-weekend loop through named Simpson and Indianola destinations, from settling in to a relaxed Sunday reset.

cards.title: Start by finding Dunn Library
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • campus orientation stop
cards.notes: Walk through the renovated building, locate the service desk, and save a study spot for later. The library lists research, archive, and group-study resources.
cards.short_summary: A practical first landmark for research help, archives, and study space.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson identifies Dunn Library as a resource and study-space hub, with group study rooms and collaborative spaces.
cards.access_notes: The official library page posts facility hours; check that page for the current schedule before going.

cards.title: Get your bearings at Kent Campus Center
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • campus-services stop
cards.notes: Use the center as an orientation anchor: identify the information desk and the student-service offices before weekend plans fill your schedule.
cards.short_summary: Simpson’s central activity and student-services building.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson describes Kent Campus Center as a hub of activity that hosts student services, entertainment, and hundreds of events.
cards.access_notes: Hours and event access vary; consult Simpson’s current event information before attending a program.

cards.title: Pause at Smith Memorial Chapel
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • campus landmark
cards.notes: Take a quiet look at the chapel and note its gathering spaces. If a public program is scheduled, confirm its details with Campus Ministry first.
cards.short_summary: A campus chapel with sanctuary, meditation, meeting, and lounge spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Smith Memorial Chapel contains the main sanctuary, meditation room, classrooms, meeting space, and Dirlam Lounge.
cards.access_notes: Campus Ministry lists weekday office hours; worship and event availability should be confirmed separately.

cards.title: Meet up at Holy Grounds
cards.subtitle: Friday evening • Dirlam Lounge, Smith Chapel
cards.notes: Use the lounge for a low-key conversation or study break. Check the shop directly for its opening schedule and any purchase requirements.
cards.short_summary: A student-managed coffee shop inside Smith Chapel’s Dirlam Lounge.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson says Holy Grounds is in Dirlam Lounge and is managed and staffed by Simpson students.
cards.access_notes: The source identifies the location but does not publish current retail hours; verify before making a special trip.

cards.title: Check the Principal Black Box calendar
cards.subtitle: Friday night • Kent Campus Center
cards.notes: Look for a scheduled performance or campus program, then confirm admission and start time through the event organizer before you head over.
cards.short_summary: A named black-box theatre on the first floor of Kent Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson identifies the Principal Black Box as a theatre on the first floor of Kent Campus Center.
cards.access_notes: Programming, admission, and hours are event-specific; confirm them with Simpson before attending.

cards.title: Take a Saturday campus walk at Buxton Park Arboretum
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning • Simpson campus
cards.notes: Make this a daylight walking stop: follow campus paths through the arboretum area and use the official campus map to orient yourself nearby.
cards.short_summary: A named arboretum destination shown on Simpson’s official campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson’s official campus map labels Buxton Park Arboretum on the Indianola campus.
cards.source_title: Simpson College AED Campus Locations Map
cards.access_notes: Use daylight and ordinary campus pedestrian routes; no public hours are stated on the map.

cards.title: Find Buxton Tennis Complex
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning • campus recreation landmark
cards.notes: Locate the complex on a daytime campus loop and check with Athletics or Campus Services before planning court use or an organized activity.
cards.short_summary: A named tennis-complex destination on Simpson’s official campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson’s official campus map labels the Buxton Tennis Complex.
cards.source_title: Simpson College AED Campus Locations Map
cards.access_notes: The map confirms the destination but does not state public court availability or hours.

cards.title: Add the Amy Robertson Music Center to your map
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • campus arts stop
cards.notes: Find the building during a campus walk, then look for a scheduled public music event through Simpson before returning for a performance.
cards.short_summary: A named Simpson music facility with a listed Music department office.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson lists the Music department at the Amy Robertson Music Center.
cards.access_notes: The department page lists weekday office hours; performance access and schedules are not stated there.

cards.title: Locate Blank Performing Arts Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • campus arts stop
cards.notes: Add this venue to your campus landmarks and check Simpson’s current arts listings for a public performance, ticketing details, and arrival guidance.
cards.evidence_claim: Simpson lists Theatre Arts at the Blank Performing Arts Center.
cards.access_notes: The department page gives weekday office hours; show access, timing, and pricing depend on the specific event.

cards.title: End with a daylight reset at Memorial Park
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon • 602 North G Street, Indianola
cards.notes: Bring a friend for a daytime walk around the park, then use the trail connection or sit near the amphitheater before preparing for the week.
cards.short_summary: An Indianola city park with an amphitheater and a Jerry Kelley Trail connection.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Indianola lists Memorial Park at 602 North G Street with an amphitheater and connection to the Jerry Kelley Trail.
cards.source_title: City Parks, Facilities and Trails | City of Indianola
cards.access_notes: Use the City of Indianola’s current park information and regulations before planning any organized activity.
